gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (governmental funds, cash basis) prints the Debt Service column's 'Debt service payments' (94,000) and 'Debt service interest' (1,169) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not under expenditures (recorded in other_financing); only 'Debt Service' 40 is an expenditure there (total expenditures 2,880,120). The Bond Fund budget schedule p9 prints the same 94,000 + 1,169 + 40 as EXPENDITURES (total 95,209). 95,169 of the -95,172 gap is this classification difference. The remaining -3 is printed rounding: the General Fund combining schedule p11 cells add to 2,880,084 vs its printed total 2,880,080 and the p4 General Fund column 2,880,080 (statement lines add to 2,880,121 = 2,880,081 + 40). 2,880,121 - 2,975,293 = -95,172 = -95,169 - 3. No detail change: both pages are as printed.

Statement p6 (proprietary, accrual) prints utility sales 632,999 + other miscellaneous 738 + interest income 306 = 634,043. The proprietary budget schedule p10 is cash basis: utility sales 636,730 + interest 306 = 637,036. Difference 2,993 = '(In)decrease in accounts receivable' 2,993 on the cash flow statement p7 (cash collections exceed accrued revenue). No fix.

Statement p6 (accrual): total operating expenses 614,120 + interest expense 3,166 = 617,286, including depreciation 157,449. Budget schedule p10 (cash basis) total expenditures 679,385 includes Capital Purchases 145,190 and Bond payments 75,000 and Debt interest 3,243, no depreciation. Reconciliation from p7: 617,286 - 157,449 depreciation + 145,190 capital purchases + 75,000 bond principal + 77 (interest 3,243 vs 3,166) - 690 accounts payable change - 29 sales tax payable change = 679,385 exactly. No fix.
